meals.name: Sticky sweet chili-lime wings with sesame-glazed carrots
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Pat 3 lb wings very dry and toss with 1 Tbsp baking powder, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Bake on a rack over a foil-lined sheet 45–50 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp and 165°F+. Start 1 cup rice.
Toss 1 lb baby carrots with 1 tsp sesame oil and a pinch of salt; roast on a second sheet for the last 25 minutes.
Simmer the glaze 3 minutes in a small pan: ⅓ cup honey, 3 Tbsp hot sauce, 1 Tbsp soy sauce, 2 Tbsp butter, 3 minced garlic cloves, zest and juice of 1 lime.
Toss the wings in most of the glaze; drizzle the rest over the carrots. Top with sliced green onions and serve with rice and lime wedges.

meals.name: Creamy lemon-garlic sausage pasta with crispy Brussels sprouts
steps: Boil 1 lb short pasta (orecchiette or penne) in well-salted water; save 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile brown 1 lb bulk Italian sausage in a large skillet over medium-high, breaking it up, until 160°F, about 7 minutes. Scoop out, leaving the fat.

Add 1 Tbsp olive oil and 1 lb Brussels sprouts (trimmed, halved) cut-side down; cook 5–6 minutes until deeply browned. Add 4 sliced garlic cloves, ½ tsp red pepper flakes and 1 tsp Italian seasoning for 30 seconds.

Pour in ½ cup broth and ½ cup heavy cream; simmer 2 minutes. Add the pasta, sausage, ½ cup grated parmesan, zest of the lemon and 1 Tbsp juice; loosen with pasta water until glossy. Season with salt and pepper.

meals.name: Smoky chipotle chicken tinga tacos with lime crema
steps: Simmer 2 lb chicken breasts in salted water with ½ onion 15–18 minutes, until 165°F. Shred with two forks; save ½ cup of the liquid.
Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a skillet; cook 1 sliced onion 5 minutes. Add 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp oregano for 30 seconds.

Blend or mash 1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes, 2–3 chipotles plus 1 Tbsp adobo, 1 tsp bouillon and 1 tsp brown sugar; add to the pan with the reserved liquid and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in the chicken and simmer 5 more minutes until saucy.
Stir ½ cup sour cream with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt. Warm the tortillas and fill with tinga, crema and cilantro; serve with lime wedges.

meals.name: Smoky chickpea & sweet potato sheet pan with garlic-lemon crema (meatless)
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut 2 lb sweet potatoes into 1-inch cubes and the red onion into wedges. Drain, rinse and pat dry 2 cans chickpeas.

Toss everything with 3 Tbsp olive oil, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic powder, ¼ tsp red pepper flakes and 1 tsp salt. Roast on a large sheet pan 30–35 minutes, stirring once, until the potatoes are tender and the chickpeas crisp.
Drizzle with 1 Tbsp honey and toss the spinach right on the hot pan to wilt.
Stir ¾ cup sour cream with 1 grated garlic clove, zest and juice of ½ lemon and a pinch of salt. Spoon over the pan and serve.

meals.name: Kung pao-style chicken with broccoli and peanuts
steps: Start 1½ cups rice. Cut 1½ lb chicken breast into bite-size pieces; toss with 1 Tbsp soy sauce and 2 tsp cornstarch.
Whisk the sauce: 3 Tbsp soy sauce, 2 Tbsp rice vinegar, 2 Tbsp honey, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp cornstarch and ¼ cup water.
Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Cook 1½ lb broccoli florets 4 minutes until charred in spots, adding 2 Tbsp water at the end; set aside.

Add 1 Tbsp oil and the chicken; cook 5–6 minutes until browned and 165°F. Add 4 minced garlic cloves and ½–1 tsp red pepper flakes for 30 seconds, then the broccoli and sauce; toss 1 minute until thick. Top with peanuts and green onions; serve over rice.

meals.name: Beefy cottage pie with garlic-butter mashed potatoes
steps: Boil 2½ lb peeled, cubed russets in salted water 15 minutes until tender. Drain and mash with 4 Tbsp butter, ½ cup warm milk, 2 grated garlic cloves, salt and pepper.
Brown 2 lb ground beef in a large oven-safe skillet until 160°F; spoon off extra fat. Add 1 diced onion and 1 cup chopped baby carrots; cook 5 minutes.

Stir in 2 Tbsp tomato paste, 2 Tbsp flour, 1 tsp dried thyme and 2 minced garlic cloves for 1 minute. Add 1½ cups water with 2 tsp beef bouillon and 1 Tbsp Worcestershire; simmer 8 minutes until thick. Stir in 1 cup frozen peas.
Heat oven to 400°F. Spread the mash over the filling, rough it up with a fork and bake 20 minutes; broil 2–3 minutes until golden. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

meals.name: Smoky sausage, potato & pepper hash with jammy eggs
steps: Dice 2 lb russet potatoes into ½-inch cubes; microwave covered with 2 Tbsp water 5 minutes to par-cook, then pat dry.

Brown a 1 lb Jimmy Dean sausage roll in a large skillet over medium-high, breaking it up, until 160°F; scoop out. Add 2 Tbsp oil and the potatoes in a single layer; cook 10–12 minutes, turning occasionally, until crisp.
Add 1 diced onion and the diced bell pepper with 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp chili powder, ½ tsp garlic powder and salt; cook 5 minutes. Return the sausage.
Make 10 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook on low 5–7 minutes until the whites are set and yolks jammy. Finish with green onions and hot sauce.
